denominators.interpretation: Coverage uses the frozen corpus, including rooms with no outcomes. Logical rows, actual chat attempts, admitted calls, completed responses, valid generations and commits are distinct. Missing cells are not silently added to rate denominators.

questions.interpretation: One retained outcome per selected object; absent objects are missing, not successful. Two questions are required for a valid pair.

gateway_accounting.interpretation: Retained sanitized log accounting; unmatched ATTEMPT_STARTED records retain their full reservation. Missing log coverage is unknown, never free.

corpus_provenance.cohort_label: Expanded exploratory corpus; adapted after original authoring outcomes and before WP4 model results.

strata.interpretation: Descriptive subset of an outcome-informed expanded exploratory corpus; identical frozen scoring.
